text: dsh-tool-vision-read 是一款面向 DSH 的图像理解工具插件，为调用模型配置独立的视觉模型路由。它注册 vision_read 工具，读取 PNG、JPEG、WebP 或 GIF 图片，并把图片送入视觉模型生成文字描述；支持一次模型调用的 direct 模式，以及可迭代处理的 subagent 模式。用户可指定关注内容、提示词、图片大小上限和输出 token 上限，适合需要让文本模型理解图片的 DSH 会话。视觉 provider 和 model 可通过环境变量配置。

dsh-tool-vision-read adds vision_read to DSH. It sends PNG, JPEG, WebP, or GIF images to a configured vision model and returns a description. Choose direct or subagent mode, and optionally set focus, prompt, and output limits.
让只能处理文本的 DSH 模型也能读懂图片。
我想让 DSH 根据图片内容生成文字说明。
能不能让图片分析固定走另一个视觉模型？
需要只关注图片里的文字或某个区域，该怎么传要求？
Let my text-only DSH model describe an image through a vision model.
I need image reading to use a separately configured model route.
dsh-tool-vision-read 的功能「读取图片并生成描述」：vision_read 接收图片路径并返回视觉模型给出的文字说明。支持 PNG、JPEG、WebP 和 GIF；图片路径按调用会话工作目录解析。
dsh-tool-vision-read 的功能「指定图片关注点」：调用 vision_read 时可传 focus，插件会把关注要求放进视觉模型提示词，并返回生成的描述。
dsh-tool-vision-read 的功能「直接视觉模型调用」：默认 direct 模式将图片作为附件交给配置的视觉路由，通过一次模型流式调用生成描述。
dsh-tool-vision-read 的功能「子 agent 图像分析」：选择 subagent 模式后，插件启动固定使用视觉路由的子 agent，由其调用 read_image 并返回文字结果。
需要配置支持图像输入的视觉模型路由；默认 kimi-coding/k3-256k，可由环境变量覆盖。
想在 DSH 里让一个视觉模型专门负责看图片。
How can my DSH agent get a text description of a local image?

@deepseek-ai/dsh-tool-vision-read README · dsh-tool-vision-read：> **Unofficial community plugin.** Independently developed and maintained; not part of the official DeepSeek Harness distribution.

A lightweight [DeepSeek Harness](https://github.com/deepseek-ai/deepseek-harness) plugin that registers a `vision_read` tool: it reads an image file **through a dedicated vision model route** and returns a text description — so a **text-only agent** (a model whose route does not declare `image` input, e.g. a chat model without vision) can still "see" images.

@deepseek-ai/dsh-tool-vision-read README · dsh-tool-vision-read：It is the same idea as routing different roles to different models (e.g. oh-my-pi's `modelRoles`), applied to one narrow capability: image description. No third-party CLI (modlens etc.), no manual delegation — the plugin does it in one call.

@deepseek-ai/dsh-tool-vision-read README · How it works：| Mode | Behavior | Cost |
|---|---|---|
| `direct` (default) | The plugin reads the file, commits it through the attachment service, and makes **one** `llm.stream` call to the configured vision provider/model with a text+image message. | One round trip, no agent loop. |
| `subagent` | The plugin starts an in-process subagent pinned to the vision route (`agentOptions`), which calls `read_image` itself and can iterate (zoom, OCR, follow-ups). | Full agent loop, more flexible. |

@deepseek-ai/dsh-tool-vision-read README · How it works：The tool always routes to the configured vision route, regardless of the calling model. Configuration parsing fails when either route id is omitted; a call resolves the route before image I/O and fails with guidance when the resolved route does not declare `image` input (declare it in the provider settings, e.g. `defaultInput: [text, image]` for pi-ai routes).

@deepseek-ai/dsh-tool-vision-read README · Requirements：- A DeepSeek Harness deployment (source checkout or out-of-tree profile install).
- A vision-capable model route. The plugin was verified against **Kimi Coding API** (`k3-256k`, which accepts image input) — any provider that supports image content blocks works.

@deepseek-ai/dsh-tool-vision-read README · Option A: inside the deepseek-harness monorepo (recommended for development)：Copy this package under `packages/vision/tool-vision-read` (or install from git), then:

```sh
pnpm install
```

Register the package in `tsconfig.base.json` (add `./packages/vision/*/src` to the `@deepseek-ai/dsh-*` wildcard and the `@deepseek-ai/dsh-*/invariant` wildcard) and in `tsconfig.host.json` references, then mount it — see the official [adding-a-package cookbook](https://github.com/deepseek-ai/deepseek-harness/blob/main/docs/cookbook/adding-a-package.md).

@deepseek-ai/dsh-tool-vision-read README · Option B: install the Profile Bundle (recommended)：Install the Git repository into a profile through the DSH plugin manager:

```sh
dsh plugin --profile web add github:Mappedinfo/dsh-tool-vision-read
```

For local development, link the checkout instead:

```sh
dsh plugin --profile web add link:/absolute/path/to/dsh-tool-vision-read
```
section: Option B: install the Profile Bundle (recommended)

text:
@deepseek-ai/dsh-tool-vision-read README · Option B: install the Profile Bundle (recommended)：The package declares a DSH Profile Bundle, so a successful install adds it to `dsh.profile.bundles`. Restart `dsh web`; its bundled `cordis.patch.yml` mounts `vision_read` automatically. The default route is `kimi-coding` / `k3-256k`. Override it for one launch without editing the package:

```sh
DSH_VISION_PROVIDER=my-provider DSH_VISION_MODEL=my-vision-model dsh web
```
section: Option B: install the Profile Bundle (recommended)

text:
@deepseek-ai/dsh-tool-vision-read README · Option B: install the Profile Bundle (recommended)：The profile's own `cordis.patch.yml` is applied after the Bundle. Use an id-targeted override when the route or other options must be durable:

```yaml
- id: tool-vision-read
  config:
    provider: my-provider
    model: my-vision-model
section: Option B: install the Profile Bundle (recommended)

text: @deepseek-ai/dsh-tool-vision-read README · Option B: install the Profile Bundle (recommended)：Do not insert a second `tool-vision-read` row in the profile. Remove the Bundle with `dsh plugin --profile web remove @deepseek-ai/dsh-tool-vision-read`. The `@deepseek-ai/*` peer packages are satisfied by the DSH installation's module closure (`$DSH_HOME/profiles/node_modules` flat fallback) — `autoInstallPeers: false` keeps pnpm from pulling older registry copies.
section: Option B: install the Profile Bundle (recommended)

text:
@deepseek-ai/dsh-tool-vision-read README · Configuration：| Key | Type | Default | Meaning |
|---|---|---|---|
| `provider` | string | — (required) | Registered provider route owning the vision model. |
| `model` | string | — (required) | Vision model id on that route. |
| `toolName` | string | `vision_read` | Model-facing tool name. |
| `mode` | `'direct' \| 'subagent'` | `'direct'` | Execution mode. |
| `maxImageBytes` | number | attachment limits | Cap on image bytes sent to the vision route. |
| `maxOutputTokens` | number | `1024` | Cap on the vision route's output tokens. |
| `prompt` | string | see source | Instruction sent beside the image; `{{path}}` and `{{focus}}` placeholders. |

@deepseek-ai/dsh-tool-vision-read README · Tool contract：```
vision_read(file_path: string, focus?: string)
```

Returns `{ path, provider, model, description }` — the vision model's text description of the image. Accepts PNG/JPEG/WebP/GIF paths only; paths resolve against the calling session's workspace cwd.

@deepseek-ai/dsh-tool-vision-read README · Example：A text-only agent (`deepseek-v4-flash`) calling `vision_read` on a campus-gate photo, with the description produced by Kimi K3-256K through the `kimi-coding` route:

```
user: 请用 vision_read 看一下 /Users/shiqi/Downloads/微信图片_20260816082109_883_131.jpg 并描述内容
agent: (vision_read) → "这是一张横构图、白天拍摄的现代城市/园区街景照片……天空与云约占画面上方 2/3……
        左侧一栋多层建筑转角呈弧形……中右一座较低的建筑带弧形屋顶边缘和竖向格栅外立面……"
```

@deepseek-ai/dsh-tool-vision-read README · Layout：```
src/index.ts          # plugin (name/inject/apply/Config) + vision_read tool
src/invariant.ts      # package invariant companion (no runtime invariant)
cordis.patch.yml      # auto-mounted DSH Profile Bundle layer
lib/                  # reference build emitted from the deepseek-harness monorepo

@deepseek-ai/dsh-tool-vision-read README · Notes：- `lib/` is the reference build generated from the package inside the [deepseek-harness](https://github.com/deepseek-ai/deepseek-harness) monorepo (`packages/vision/tool-vision-read`); the tests run against the monorepo toolchain. The git dependency installs the committed `lib/` directly.
- Developed and verified end-to-end: a text-only agent (deepseek-v4-flash) calling `vision_read` on a JPEG received a correct description from Kimi K3-256K.
